## Problem Description
A clear and concise description of the problem or limitation you are facing.
*Example: I am trying to understand reviewer response times, but currently cannot filter by...*

## Proposed Solution
A clear and concise description of the feature or metric you would like to see added:
- **Command / Subcommand**: (e.g. `gh pr-pro <domain> <subcommand>`)
- **Key Metrics & Statistics**: (e.g. p50/p90 percentiles, counts, ratios)
- **Proposed Flags & Groupings**: (e.g. `--group-by`, `--filter`, `--past`)

## Alternatives Considered
A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions, scripts, or workarounds you have considered.

## Additional Context
Add any other context, mockup tables, GraphQL schema references, or screenshots about the feature request here.
